title: Atlas 2.2 package capability-maturity source of truth
description: Single source of truth mapping each Atlas 2.2 package/capability to a maturity class. The prep-guard branch-scope tests key on this file instead of a blanket 'no src/ on any 2.2 branch' rule. A 'prep-frozen' package remains doc/contract/fixture only: its declared production_surface must NOT be mutated by any branch (DENY). An 'implementation-unlocked' capability has real authorized runtime evidence merged on main and MAY legitimately mutate its production_surface under normal governance (ALLOW). This does NOT delete the PREP<->IMPLEMENTATION boundary and is NOT a blanket 2.2 unlock: unlock is per-capability and evidence-driven. Flip a package to 'implementation-unlocked' here (with runtime evidence) at the moment its production surface is authorized.

gates.note: SELECTIVE = per-capability unlock keyed on merged runtime evidence, never a blanket 2.2 unlock. prep-frozen packages stay frozen.

surface_notes: production_surface lists src paths that constitute a package's own 2.2 production surface (files ending in '/' are treated as directory prefixes). For prep-frozen packages this is the DENY set. Pan-core shared modules (e.g. knowledge_compiler.py, api_server.py, authz.py, ops_health.py) are intentionally NOT owned by 2.2 prep packages: they are governed by core's own tests, so 2.2 prep guards must not claim them (that was a source of false positives on legitimate branches).
